cards.ex: Everyone should have their say before we make a final decision.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy qaror qabul qilishdan oldin har bir kishi o'z fikrini bildirish kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini yoki nuqtai nazarini to'liq ifoda etishga imkoniyatga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get through to him sometimes; he just doesn't listen.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan unga tushuntirish qiyin; u shunchaki eshitmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot, g'oya yoki his-tuyg'ularni muvaffaqiyatli tushuntirish yoki yetkazish.

cards.ex: I wanted to criticize, but I held back because he was already upset.
cards.exUz: Men tanqid qilmoqchi edim, lekin u allaqachon xafa bo'lgani uchun o'zimni tiydim.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrlarini yoki his-tuyg'ularini ifoda etishdan o'zini tiyish.

cards.ex: Saying 'it's raining cats and dogs' is a figure of speech.
cards.exUz: 'Yomg'ir shiddat bilan yog'yapti' deyish obrazli ifodadir.
cards.uzDef: So'zlarning oddiy, haqiqiy ma'nosidan farqli ravishda ishlatilishi.

cards.ex: The beauty of the sunset was so overwhelming, words failed me.
cards.exUz: Quyosh botishining go'zalligi shunchalik kuchliki, so'z topolmadim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir juda hayratlanarli yoki ta'sirli bo'lgani uchun so'z bilan ifodalash qiyin.

cards.ex: I think you're missing the point; it's not about the money.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz mohiyatni tushunmayapsiz; gap pulda emas.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy g'oyani yoki argumentni tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: He was able to put his ideas across effectively during the presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimot davomida o'z g'oyalarini samarali tarzda yetkaza oldi.
cards.uzDef: G'oyani yoki ma'lumotni aniq va tushunarli tarzda ifodalash.

cards.ex: The humor of the joke was lost in translation.
cards.exUz: Hazilning yumori tarjimada yo'qoldi.
cards.uzDef: So'zma-so'z tarjima qilinganda ma'nosi yo'qoladigan narsa.

cards.ex: It was just a slip of the tongue; I didn't mean to offend you.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki til uchishi edi; men sizni xafa qilmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri so'zni aytib yuborish, adashib ketish.

cards.ex: She has a knack for explaining complicated topics simply.
cards.exUz: U murakkab mavzularni oddiy qilib tushuntirish qobiliyatiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilish uchun tabiiy qobiliyatga yoki iste'dodga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I can read him like a book; I know when he's lying.
cards.exUz: Men uni kitob kabi o'qiy olaman; u qachon yolg'on gapirayotganini bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir his-tuyg'ulari yoki niyatlarini fahmlash.

cards.ex: I hate making small talk at parties, but it's necessary.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatlarda bepul suhbat qilishni yomon ko'raman, lekin bu zarur.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan, qisqa suhbat, odatda begonalar bilan.

cards.ex: We were talking at cross-purposes; I was referring to last week, and she was talking about today.
cards.exUz: Biz bir-birimizni tushunmay suhbatlashayotgan edik; men o'tgan haftani nazarda tutayotgan edim, u esa bugun haqida gapirayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini tushunmaydigan tarzda suhbatlashish, turli narsalar haqida gapirish.

cards.ex: Her name is on the tip of my tongue, but I just can't remember it.
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida turibdi, lekin eslay olmayapman.
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue
cards.uzDef: So'zni eslay olmaslik, lekin tez orada eslashni bilish.

cards.ex: Don't mince words; tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Aylanib gapirmang; menga nima deb o'ylashingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapirishdan qochish, xushomad qilish.

cards.ex: The debate turned into a war of words between the two candidates.
cards.exUz: Debat ikki nomzod o'rtasida bahs-munozaraga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Qizg'in bahs yoki kelishmovchilik, odatda ommaviy.

cards.ex: That lecture gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Bu ma'ruza menga mulohaza uchun ko'p ozuqa berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga undaydigan, qiziqarli g'oya yoki ma'lumot.

cards.ex: He didn't say it in so many words, but he implied it.
cards.exUz: U buni shunday so'zlar bilan aytmadi, lekin ishora qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aniq so'zlar bilan aytilmagan bo'lsa ham, shu ma'noda.

cards.ex: I heard on good authority that the company is merging.
cards.exUz: Men ishonchli manbadan kompaniya birlashayotganini eshitdim.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchli manbadan olingan ma'lumotga ko'ra.

cards.ex: The speaker used several examples to drive home his point.
cards.exUz: Notiq o'z fikrini ta'kidlash uchun bir nechta misollardan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: G'oyani yoki fikrni aniq va kuchli tarzda ta'kidlash.

cards.ex: I think we got our wires crossed; I thought you were bringing the drinks.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, biz chalkashib ketdik; Men siz ichimliklarni olib kelasiz deb o'ylagan edim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri tushunish, chalkashib ketish.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade: this project is a disaster.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni aytaylik: bu loyiha falokat.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni beziyaksiz, to'g'ri aytish.

cards.ex: Talk of the devil! I was just telling Sarah about you.
cards.exUz: Eshak keldi! Men hozirgina Saraga siz haqida gapirayotgan edim.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir haqida gaplashayotganingizda paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: He's not interested; in other words, don't bother calling.
cards.exUz: U qiziqmaydi; boshqacha qilib aytganda, qo'ng'iroq qilmang.
cards.uzDef: Avval aytilgan narsani boshqacha usulda takrorlash.

cards.ex: Do I need to spell it out for you? You're fired.
cards.exUz: Sizga buni tushuntirib berishim kerakmi? Siz ishdan bo'shatildingiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda aniq va batafsil tushuntirish, soddalashtirib.

cards.ex: The long and short of it is, we can't afford it.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz buni qurbimiz yetmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning asosiy nuqtasi yoki yakuni.

cards.ex: He has a golden tongue and can convince anyone of anything.
cards.exUz: U chuchuk zabonga ega va har kimni har narsaga ishontira oladi.
cards.uzDef: Gapirishda juda mahoratli, odamlarni ishontira oladigan odam.

cards.ex: You need to weigh your words carefully when speaking to the press.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari bilan gaplashganda so'zlaringizni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Gapirishdan oldin so'zlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan tanlash.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling by brainstorming some ideas.
cards.exUz: Keling, bir nechta g'oyalarni yig'ish orqali ishni boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror loyihani yoki jarayonni boshlash.

cards.ex: I told him in no uncertain terms that I was leaving.
cards.exUz: Men unga ketayotganimni aniq qilib aytdim.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday ikkilanishsiz, juda aniq va tushunarli qilib.
